race.comment: SURROUND ME (4) hasn't been far away this campaign and looks poised to strike third-up. She was only 1.6L off the winner last start at Pinjarra and the extra 100m is a big tick. Pike sticks with her, she maps well and with further improvement expected, she can get the job done. SUPER SENTAI (3) ran over the top to score in a photo finish at this track after settling in a midfield position. Chris Parnham sticks with him and he looks to have plenty of upside. Can build on the fresh win out in trip now and keep the ball rolling. OCEAN GODDESS (5) resumes today and is a fresh winner in the past. Carberry sticks with her from the recent trial and if she can pick up from where she left off last campaign, she'll be right in the finish. CATCH CARTER (1) is ticking along nicely and has to be included. COSMIC ECLIPSE (10) can feature.
